senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. שָׁמַם) [to stand still,] to be astonished, amazed; to wonder; to be undecided. Pesik. R. addit., s. 1 והבריות תּוֹמְהִים לומר וכ׳ and men wondered, saying, is such a thing possible? Ib. על דור המגדל אתם תּוֹמְהִין וכ׳ you wonder at what occurred to the generation of the tower: has not such a thing occurred &c.? Yalk. Ex. 166 וַיִתְמְהוּ תמיהא גדולה מאד and they wondered exceedingly. Pesik. Haḥod., p. 43ᵃ היה … יושב ותָמֵהַּ בלבו וכ׳ Abraham sat and was undecided in his heart, saying, which shall I choose?; Gen. R. s. 44.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 12:14">Gen. R. s. 12</cite> <he>מלך … ועמד לו תָּמֵיהַּ</he> a king that rebuked his servant, and he stood there confounded.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 12:14">Ib.</cite> <he>תמיה אני איך וכ׳</he> I wonder how great men … could disagree on &c.
<cite ref="Yevamot 96b:15">Yeb. 96ᵇ</cite> <he>תמיה אני אם לא וכ׳</he> I should wonder, if this synagogue did not become an idolatrous temple.
<cite ref="Arakhin 16b">Arakh. 16ᵇ</cite> <he>תְּמִיהַנִי יש וכ׳</he> I wonder if there is in this generation &c.
<cite ref="Mishnah Pesachim 6:2">Pes. VI, 2</cite> <he>אל תִּתְמֵהּ על אלו</he> do not wonder at that Y. ib. 33ᵇ bot. <he>תמיהני היאך וכ׳</he> I wonder how R. El. could accept such an answer.

<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 202:2">Yalk. Ex. 202</cite> <he>תְּמַהּ על עצמה היאך וכ׳</he> wonder at the very thing, why should leavened matter be forbidden &c.; <cite ref="Pesachim 28b:1">Pes. 28ᵇ</cite> <he>תמה על עצמך</he> (corr. acc.); a. fr.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 98:12">Gen. R. s. 98</cite> <he>על אלו אתם מַתְמִיהִין</he> you wonder at that? if you were to see <he>היה לכם … להַתְמִיהַּ יותר</he> (not <he>להתמה</he>) you would wonder still more.
<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 28:1">Pesik. R. s. 28</cite> <he>מַתְמִיהִין</he> (not <he>מתמהין</he>); a. e.
Men. 40ᵃ אינו אלא מן המַתְמִיהִין is one of those who make people wonder at their strange conduct; (Ms. M. המוּתְמָהִין Hof. of those wondered at).
<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 764:3">Yalk. Num. 764</cite> <he>אף אתה מן המַתְמִיהִים</he> art thou, too, of the inventors of miracles?
